bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
base=b44c2d73d4e7acbd00ed4f96c41c2fedeb494c4c
head=21c3d225900887116d0e50e4e8f4af7eb3619261
git -C "$repo" fetch --no-tags origin feat/video-paidmedia-invoice-dual-mode-20261124 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 31
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head" || exit 32
mask=0
n=1
for p in src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs src/sales/pgStarsLedger.mjs src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs; do
  basehash="$(git -C "$repo" show "$base:$p" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')" || exit 33
  livehash="$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$p" | awk '{print $1}')" || exit 34
  if test "$basehash" != "$livehash"; then mask=$((mask+n)); fi
  n=$((n*2))
done
exit $((100+mask))
